scope: Inner CV inside original split-42 training molecules only
candidates: equal blend of v2 and text semantic head
equal blend of v2 and structure+text semantic head
baseline: Fully nested v2 OOF predictions from runs/nose-semantic-trees-inner-v2
alignment_required: Exact equality of molecule IDs and target values before reusing baseline predictions
promotion_rule: Mean Pearson gain at least 0.01 over v2 and positive gain in at least two repeats; otherwise retain v2
test_use: No main validation/test or reserved targets used for candidate selection
independent_experiment: Development train+validation refit is measured separately and does not change this selection rule
